data.body:
Implemented + pushed as Gerrit change 1884 (commit 6c1a4cf, off origin/main incl. blusterous). 

Local results (worktree venv):
- tests/interfaces/test_write_parity_oracle.py: 25 passed, 5 xfailed (the 5 MCP force/reason/caused_by/ref+claim-force gap rows, strict-xfail citing scratchy-leprous-galago). 30 = 10 cases x 3 adapters.
- Full tests/interfaces tier: 1890 passed + my 5 xfailed. The only failures (4 failed + 3 errors: test_rebar_repo_isolation, test_tracker_config_e2e, test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout, test_mcp_push_status) reproduce IDENTICALLY on a pristine origin/main worktree with 'fatal: cannot use bare repository ... (safe.bareRepository is explicit)' -- a local git-config artifact of this machine, not the change. CI Linux runners lack that config.
- make lint (incl. complexity ratchet) + make typecheck: green. Change is test-only (no src/rebar edits), so module-size/complexity gates don't apply.

Contract cases: create baseline (parity control), optimistic-concurrency wrong-current (shared exit-10 rejection control), close_class valid bug-close (parity positive: exposed on all three incl. MCP), close_class-missing + reason-required-missing bug-close (runtime conditional rules, refused identically -- same exit code -- on all three), and the 5 MCP-gap rows (force on transition-close, force on claim, reason-as-close_reason, caused_by on bug-close, ref on close). file_impact updated to 3 paths (added adapters.py). Will re-run review-plan to re-certify before close.
